assessment: The official district land-record page and map digitization dashboard establish district land records. Public viewer selectors returned district 194, Sadar tehsil 00984, and its village list. The city-named village option `सिपाह शहर जौनपुर` hasData false. No full polygon was returned or selected.
registryAssessment: Jaunpur District Administration identifies the state Bhulekh land-record system and all tehsils; the UP cadastral-map selector returned Jaunpur district, Sadar tehsil, and revenue-village options. A city-named Sadar option, Sipah Shahar Jaunpur, was listed with `hasData:false`; no claim is made that it contains the WUP point.
